nvitk.core.patterns
===================

.. py:module:: nvitk.core.patterns

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Reusable patterns (e.g. singleton metaclass).



Classes

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.core.patterns.Singleton


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: Singleton

   Bases: :py:obj:`type`


   Metaclass that returns the same instance for each ``cls(*args, **kwargs)`` call.

   The instance is stored on ``cls._instances[cls]``. Used by :class:`~nvitk.core.logger.Logger`.


   .. py:attribute:: _instances


   .. py:method:: __call__(*args, **kwargs)

      Return the cached instance for *cls*, constructing it on first call.
